metadata.title: A Galactic Center Origin for HE 0437-5439, the Hypervelocity Star near the Large Magellanic Cloud

evidence.quote: called HVS3 in the catalog of

Hypervelocity stars (HVSs) are stars escaping the
Milky Way.

One of the most intriguing HVSs is HE 0437−5439
(Edelmann et al. 2005), called HVS3 in the catalog of
Brown et al. (2009).

We measure the proper motion of HVS3 and find that
its velocity vector points from the Milky Way.

notes: HE 0437−5439 (= HVS3): The paper follows up this previously identified HVS and concludes that it was ejected from the Galactic center by the central MBH (T:p1-b11, T:p5-b4). No Gaia identifier is supplied.

HE 0437−5439: RA and Dec are retained in the paper's sexagesimal J2000 notation without conversion. The proper-motion errors are recorded with separate 1σ statistical and systematic components from Table 1 and the abstract; the text also discusses a ±0.58 mas/yr systematic in the readout direction (T:p2-b6). No numerical annual parallax, present-day galactocentric radius, total Galactic rest-frame speed, or bound/unbound probability is explicitly reported for the star.
